visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a purple ribbed crop top and black jeans, stands on a paved road. She gestures enthusiastically with her hands while looking directly into the camera. The background shows a lush green agricultural field and rolling hills under bright, natural daylight. (2) Close-up shots of a black Insta360 Ace Pro 2 camera are shown against a stylized black background with red highlights. The lens reflects light, and the physical texture of the camera body is visible. (3) The woman holds the action camera mounted on a small black tripod/selfie stick. She moves the camera around to demonstrate its size and form factor. (4) Split-screen comparison shots appear. One side shows the woman on a windy beach wearing a green raincoat, her hair blowing wildly. The other side shows a different person holding a camera. (5) Multiple close-up phases demonstrate the camera's flip-up screen being adjusted at various angles. The woman's hands are visible manipulating the hinge mechanism. (6) A sequence of night footage plays, showing a motorcycle traveling on a highway and a stationary green mail van in a parking lot, demonstrating low-light performance. (7) Screen recordings of a smartphone interface show the official Insta360 store with various product listings and discount prices. (8) The woman returns to the roadside setting, pointing towards the camera and performing a stylized hand-swiping gesture as if ending the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a high-pitched, enthusiastic, and fast-paced manner over a rhythmic electronic BGM with a strong kick drum and synth bass. The environment sounds clean, suggesting a field recording with high-quality equipment. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition as the BGM maintains its tempo. The speaker's pitch remains high and consistent. (3) A sudden acoustic shift occurs to demonstrate audio testing. A loud, broadband wind noise bursts through for 1 second (demonstrating poor audio), followed immediately by the speaker's voice sounding exceptionally clear despite audible background wind textures, signifying a noise reduction feature. (4) A series of metallic 'clicks' and 'pops' are heard as the visuals show the camera screen flipping. The music tempo remains steady at approximately 125 BPM. (5) The speaker introduces the 'Night Mode' feature with increased vocal energy (high arousal). The BGM continues with a bright, percussive electronic texture. (6) A digital 'ding' and 'shimmer' sound effect accompany the reveal of discount information. The voice becomes more persuasive and friendly. (7) The video concludes with a fast-paced summary, ending with a final energetic vocal phrase and a sharp fade-out of the music and ambient room tone.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for the Insta360 Ace Pro 2 action camera. It highlights three key selling points: superior wind-noise reduction, a versatile flip screen, and enhanced AI-driven night photography. The intent is to drive sales by showcasing a Spring promotion discount code.
